use axum::{routing::post, Router};

pub struct ChatService;

impl ChatService {
    pub async fn stream(&self) -> String {
        self.finish()
    }
    fn finish(&self) -> String { String::new() }
}

pub fn app() -> Router {
    Router::new().route("/chat/stream", post(handler))
}

async fn handler() -> String { String::new() }
